judged_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:35 — `group.set("offset", offset);` commits pagination before `return group.findMembers();` succeeds, so a failed Next or Previous request leaves the previous members displayed under the new page number and the next navigation skips from the failed offset without rollback.
